area: Poplar / Blackwall: East India Dock Road and Dock Wall Road with the East India Dock premises to the north, Naval Row, Quixley/Scouler/Harrap/Prestage Streets, Poplar Station, Brunswick Street bridge, Leicester and Gaselee Streets, Poplar Dock (M.R.) sidings, G.N.R. goods depot, Blackwall Yard graving docks
method: sheet + 9 sweep crops at 2x (anchors: r0c0 Naval Row South, Shipwrights Terrace; r0c1 EAST INDIA DOCK, HARRAP/SCOULER/QUIXLEY/PRESTAGE STREET; r0c2 Great Northern Railway Goods Depot, DOCK WALL ROAD; r1c0 Poplar Station, Smithy, LEICESTER STREET; r1c1 PRESTAGE STREET, sidings; r1c2 Blackwall Yard, LONDON & BLACKWALL; r2c0 GASELEE STREET, PRESTO(N), Crane; r2c1 POPLAR DOCK (M.R.), Saw Pit; r2c2 GRAVING DOCK, Caisson). Contact sheets f1-f3, f5, f8 (5x), f4 (9x), f6-f7 (12x B.M. decimals), f9 (6x), nn2 (6x/10x digit comparison), region views sm, a, rA, rB, rD, rG, rR, rS, rT, r15 (3-8x), marker sheets mk6/mk7 (5x). Every crop and sheet displayed when opened; anchors in notes.
legibility: Clean print. Vertical straight line at px ~49-52 the full height (tool-reported join; coincides with the railway fence along Preston Road in the south). Many figures sit beside lettering dots, mooring posts or F.P. dots; given medium. Railway sidings and the dock interiors carry no figures.
